user_story: As a user, I want task creation to fail when an invalid category is provided so that data stays consistent.

positive.title: Successful task creation with valid category
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter task details with a valid category.
positive.expected_result: The task is created successfully, and the user receives a confirmation message.

negative.title: Task creation fails with invalid category
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter task details with an invalid category.
negative.expected_result: The task creation fails, and the user receives an error message about the invalid category.

edge.title: Task creation with a borderline category name length
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter task details where the category has the maximum allowed character length.
edge.expected_result: The task creation succeeds if the category length is within the limit; fails with a relevant message if it exceeds the limit.
